fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. "Then he brought me into the outer court…" (Ezekiel 40:17). Ezekiel just watched a whole gate get measured, and now he's led inside to chambers and a pavement laid out all around, with thirty chambers facing the pavement. I think Ezekiel's feet need a nap by now. That man has a rod in his hand and ground to cover.

That's right, baker. The man says, "These are the sons of Zadok, the only Levites who may approach the LORD to minister before Him." (Ezekiel 40:46). Look at who's getting set apart here: not all the Levites, just Zadok's sons. The man is handing out the closest spot in the whole temple, and he's got a very short list.
